release.note: README, Specification, no longer says the test's data has no subnormal operand: it says A is the test's normaliser up to the subnormal operands' excess, 0 to 102 subnormal operands per matrix and at most 1.9e-7 relative on the sampled shapes, which is what round-1/r-sk/work/subnormals.out recorded; the per-shape bounds hold to the digits given.

notes: Gate and item digests unchanged since round 1. The new README sentence on what Post does not reject checks by arithmetic: tol/A is 4.76e-4 at T = 30 and 4.92e-4 at T = 31 (K = 1921 is the first K with T = 31), against 4.88e-4 for one float16 rounding.
